1. Website Cost Calculator & Estimation Disclaimer

The pricing figures calculated by the Website Cost Calculator Tool on this website are provided strictly for general estimation, comparison, and budgeting purposes. While our calculator is calibrated to reflect realistic development and SEO rates in New Zealand and international markets, the output does not constitute a legally binding quote or formal contract.

Final pricing for any specific engagement is subject to a comprehensive technical discovery, written scope specification, and formal Statement of Work agreed upon by both parties.

2. Search Engine Optimization (SEO) & Ranking Projections

While WEBSOL Digital Solutions employs industry-recognized white-hat SEO methodologies and best practices designed to maximize organic visibility and Google search rankings, search algorithms (including Google, Bing, and others) are proprietary, dynamic, and subject to regular updates.

Consequently, no agency or consultant can ethically guarantee a permanent or fixed #1 organic ranking position for specific competitive keywords. Case studies, historical traffic graphs, and testimonials displayed on our website represent past client outcomes and are not a guarantee of future identical performance for every unique domain.

3. External Links & Third-Party Platforms

Our website and blog articles may contain links to external third-party websites, plugins, software tools, or payment gateways. WEBSOL Digital Solutions has no control over the content, policies, or operational uptime of these external platforms and assumes no liability for their performance or privacy practices.

4. General Information & Professional Advice

The content, articles, and guides published on this website are provided for general educational and informational purposes only. They do not constitute formal legal, accounting, or professional financial advice.
